PUBLICLY STATED PROCEDURE VOLUME, quoted verbatim from the clinic site: 'more than 1,200 successful surgeries'. SECOND SELF-BRANDED WEBSITE: drguruprasadreddy.com, marketed around 'Best Cosmetic Surgeon In Jubilee Hills'. TWO INTERNATIONAL FELLOWSHIPS: FDAFPRS (Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery) in IRELAND and FAOCMF in SEOUL, SOUTH KOREA, plus an AOCMF Fellowship. HIGHLY MULTI-SITE: five concurrent practice locations - Apollo Health City Jubilee Hills, Apollo Spectra Kondapur, Apollo Cradle Kondapur, Tanvir Hospital Srinagar Colony, and his own Aroha Aesthetics Gachibowli. PREMIUM SELF-PAY SPECIALTY: cosmetic and aesthetic surgery is almost entirely private-pay - body contouring, breast surgery, rhinoplasty, hair transplant, cosmetic gynaecology and Morpheus8 - the highest-margin clinical mix in this batch. Member of seven professional bodies: NABI, AOCMFA, ASPS, ISSH, APSI, ISPNS and ILCSPCA. Registered with the Andhra Pradesh Medical Council. Holds a dedicated Apollo Health City consulting room (Room 9056, International Block).

notes: Identity verified on name + specialty (plastic/cosmetic surgery) + hospital (Apollo Health City, Jubilee Hills) + city from Apollo's own doctor page, which also publishes his individual consulting room number there. Band is MEDIUM, not High, and deliberately so: apollohospitals.com, apollo247.com, apollospectra.com, apollocradle.com and apolloclinic.com are all Apollo-group domains and count as ONE source under the banding rule; his clinic site arohaaesthetics.com and his personal site drguruprasadreddy.com are primary self-published sources and cannot earn High; Practo, Lybrate, Skedoc, HexaHealth, iCliniq and Curofy are corroborating-only. A targeted healinindia.gov.in / government-registry query returned nothing, and no LinkedIn profile surfaced, so no independent second official source exists. CONTACTS - both passed the mandatory exact-phrase re-check against his OWN clinic: 'contact@arohaaesthetics.com' returned several real indexed pages on arohaaesthetics.com (contact-us, lip augmentation, female hair transplant, a blog article); '8500600789' returned the arohaaesthetics.com contact-us page. EXPLICITLY REJECTED, each checked and thrown out: 04069321004, which two summaries presented as his number - it is Apollo's central switchboard and belongs to no individual; 1860-500-2244 and 1860-500-4424, Apollo Spectra and Apollo Cradle central booking lines; and 8377805564, which an exact-phrase check proved to be HexaHealth's own 24/7 aggregator helpline rather than the clinic's line. JustDial listings were ignored as call-tracking proxies. owns_clinic set TRUE on the published wording 'Aroha Aesthetics is led by Dr. Guru Prasad Reddy' plus his dedicated page on that clinic's site and his separate personal marketing domain - but note the sites say 'led by' and 'practising at' rather than 'founder' or 'owner', so a human should confirm the actual shareholding before treating it as proprietorship. INSTAGRAM DELIBERATELY LEFT BLANK: two competing handles surfaced, https://www.instagram.com/arohaaesthetics/ and https://www.instagram.com/aroha_aesthetics/, both titled for AROHA Aesthetics, and nothing in the results tied either one specifically to this clinic rather than the other; recording one would be a coin flip. The Facebook page IS recorded because a result explicitly paired 'AROHA Aesthetics' on Facebook with the www.arohaaesthetics.com domain - note it is the CLINIC's page, not his personal account. OTHER ITEMS FOR A HUMAN: experience is stated as 12+ years by Apollo but 17+ years by his own clinic; the clinic postcode appears as both 500008 and 500104 across sources; and he is listed under name variants 'Dr. Gorla Guruprasad Reddy' (iCliniq) and 'Dr. Guru Prasad Reddy G' (Curofy), suggesting the surname initial G.
